scope: Post-learning read-only comparison of public task commands, sealed helper and public artifact snapshots. No private grader checks, model reasoning or diagnosis were read.

execution.selection_normal_and_post_final: Both use the sealed generate_stats / validate_stats default policy on the original packet capture and preserved original CSV template.
execution.independent: First uses the same default entry, then reads packet evidence and invokes sealed run_config with an explicit has_port_scan=true override and a stated rationale. The sealed helper recalculates is_traffic_benign from the revised flags.
execution.intermediate_task_script_syntax_error: A generated task runner had a syntax error, was corrected, and later completed successfully before official grading; this is not an unresolved provider operation.

independent_episode_to_snapshot_binding.method: Hash the exact literal of the final public runner written by the independent execution command; only one public snapshot contains that file hash. No command body is included in this projection.

interpretation: The same sealed package permits more than one qualitative flag decision. Fresh execution changed two permitted flag values while preserving input bytes and all numeric statistics; its official group count was lower. This demonstrates execution variation, not a missing package or changed input. The exact private grading obligation responsible for the two lost groups remains unassigned by this public-only review.
privacy: No raw commands, private host paths, reasoning, diagnosis, official test names or assertion contents included.
